audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored 'Skill' while its own text says his ultimate outpaces yours; first item and 2+ items were scored for Renekton while whys[5], whys[6], spikes[3] and the late paragraph all say the lane flips to Trundle there.
audit.why: 48.54% over 274 games is a shallow loss, and it comes from lane, not from the side lane. The stages were labelled in the wrong direction at both ends.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Renekton / Renekton / Skill / Renekton / Trundle / Trundle in both layers, with the level 6 why rewritten around Dominus.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike said 'Subjugate returns far less value against a bruiser than a tank' — the reverse of what the two ultimates actually do to each other.
audit.why: Dominus grants Renekton bonus max Health, and Subjugate steals a percent of the target's Health as well as Armor and Magic Resistance. The bigger he makes himself, the more your ultimate takes off him. Answering Dominus with Subjugate is the single highest-value button press in the matchup and the old text told players the opposite.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten in spikes[1], whys[4], mid and phases[4].why as 'answer R with R', with Dominus's 120/100/80 cooldown named.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never named a single Renekton ability — only 'E dash', 'W stun', 'his R'. It also missed the two effects that decide trades: the 50-Fury Ruthless Predator stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s AND destroys damage shields on the target, and empowered Slice and Dice reduces your Armor. wants.you[0] also claimed Chomp slows his attack speed; Chomp saps Attack Damage and slows movement.
audit.why: Both Fury thresholds are the matchup. Doubling the stun is what turns a survivable trade into a lost one, and the shield-destroy changes what you are allowed to buy.
audit.corrected: Cull the Meek, Ruthless Predator, Slice and Dice, Dominus and Reign of Anger named throughout, with the 0.75s/1.5s split, the shield destruction, and the armour shred all stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommended Sterak's Gage in a matchup where a 50-Fury Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on its target.
audit.why: Riot's Ruthless Predator text names shield destruction explicitly, and Sterak's Gage is a damage shield. Recommending it here spends 3000g on something he deletes with a button he presses every fight.
audit.corrected: Sterak's Gage flagged in report[8] with the reason; Executioner's Calling kept as the first back, which the missing-interactions file also asks for against Cull the Meek's heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the content layer.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1 and Slice and Dice is 16s at rank 1 — both very long early, and both spent in the opening beat of his combo. Cull the Meek is a flat 7s. Those three numbers define every window you get.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into early, mid, whys[1], whys[2], phases and breakdown.cooldowns, with 'Pillar behind him after the dash costs him the whole 16 seconds'.

edits.before: Renekton's E-W-Q-E combo with fury-empowered W stun comes fully online — his point-click burst wins short trades before your Frozen Domain can equalise them.
edits.after: Slice and Dice into a 50-Fury Ruthless Predator stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s — that doubled stun is the whole trade, and Cull the Meek heals him through it.

edits.before: Renekton's R inflates his HP and combat stats for a prolonged all-in; Subjugate returns far less value against a bruiser than a tank, so his power spike outpaces yours here.
edits.after: Dominus (120s at rank 1) inflates his max Health for the long all-in — and Subjugate steals a percent of Health, so ulting into his ult pays more here, not less. Answer R with R.

edits.before: Renekton's kit falls off dramatically without early advantages — your Chomp AD-steal, Frozen Domain healing, and Subjugate make every extended fight his nightmare.
edits.after: Renekton falls off hard without an early lead — Chomp's AD sap, Frozen Domain healing, and a Subjugate that eats the Dominus health make every long fight his nightmare.

edits.before: Land Chomp on every Renekton trade to chip his AD and slow his attack speed so his fury-empowered exchanges become less lethal
edits.after: Land Chomp every 3.5s to sap his attack damage and slow him, so each 50-Fury Ruthless Predator window comes back weaker

edits.before: Open trades with E dash to close distance, W-stun you before you can respond, then disengage before your Frozen Domain grants you full value
edits.after: Open with Slice and Dice, land a 50-Fury Ruthless Predator for the 1.5s stun, then dash back out before Frozen Domain pays you anything

edits.before: Stack fury quickly on minions and look for the fury-empowered W burst window the moment Chomp is on cooldown
edits.after: Stack Fury on the wave with Cull the Meek and cash the empowered Ruthless Predator while Chomp is down

edits.before: Both champions have punishing level-1 autos — Chomp's AD steal matches Renekton's base damage; Q on his first step up, then hold position and do not chase.
edits.after: Level 1 is a coin flip of autos — Chomp's AD sap answers his base damage, but Cull the Meek (7s) heals it back, so bite on his step-up and hold position.

edits.before: Renekton's fury-empowered W stun comes online and he can E-stun-Q-E before Frozen Domain equalises the exchange — hold W for the counter-plant after his gap-close.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator arrives at 16s on rank 1, and at 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s rather than 0.75s — that is the whole trade. Hold Frozen Domain for after his dash.

edits.before: His full E-W-Q-E combo at level 3 outraces your healing if he lands it clean; Pillar of Ice behind him cuts the escape E and forces a longer fight you are not yet winning.
edits.after: His level-3 rotation outruns your healing if it lands clean; Slice and Dice (16s at rank 1) is both his entry and his exit, so Pillar of Ice behind him buys the longer fight.

edits.before: His R inflates combat stats for a full sustained all-in, and Subjugate drains less from a bruiser than a tank; survive this window by using Pillar to interrupt his second E dash.
edits.after: Dominus (120s at rank 1) hands him bonus max Health for a sustained all-in — and Subjugate steals a percent of Health, so cast yours into his and take that inflation off him.

edits.before: Renekton has no meaningful late-game scaling; lock him in your Frozen Domain with Pillar of Ice, stack the Chomp AD theft across the fight, and Subjugate whatever armour he has built.
edits.after: Renekton has no late scaling; lock him in Frozen Domain with Pillar of Ice, stack Chomp's AD sap across the fight, and Subjugate the armour and Dominus health he has built.

edits.before: Renekton owns levels 2 and 3 — his E-dash into fury-empowered W stun is a point-click burst combo that fires before your Frozen Domain can equalise the exchange. At level 1 you can trade evenly: Q-Chomp his first last-hit attempt to front-load the AD steal, but back off before he stacks fury. The moment he hits level 2, respect the W stun — if he lands it, he chains the full E-W-Q-E and you lose that trade cleanly. Keep the wave slightly on your side of mid-lane so his E dash starts in the open rather than from river brush; it does not help you avoid the stun but it reduces his ability to double-dash all-in off the flank.
edits.after: Renekton owns levels 2 and 3 — Slice and Dice (16s at rank 1) into a 50-Fury Ruthless Predator stuns you for 1.5 seconds instead of 0.75, and that gap is the whole trade. At level 1 you can trade evenly: Chomp his first last-hit attempt to front-load the AD sap, then back off before he stacks Fury. Cull the Meek is a flat 7-second heal that hits the whole wave, so chip damage alone never gets him low — buy Grievous Wounds before you plan an all-in. Keep the wave slightly on your side of mid-lane so his dash has to start in the open rather than out of the river brush, and hold Pillar of Ice for the exit, not the entry.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are contested because Renekton loses fury between skirmishes and your Chomp ranks up, but he can still burst you if you step up with Pillar on cooldown and no Frozen Domain pre-placed. The real question is whether you survive to Level 6 even in health. His R is not the Subjugate you hoped for in this matchup — Renekton is not a tank, so the resistance drain returns modest value compared to a Malphite or Ornn. He uses R to extend the all-in and not die to your healing, which makes the Level 6 window roughly his rather than yours. Use Pillar of Ice defensively here: if he dashes in, place it behind him immediately to cut off the second E and force him to trade in your Frozen Domain instead of escaping on his own terms.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are contested because Renekton bleeds Fury between skirmishes and your Chomp ranks up, but he still bursts you if you step up with Pillar down and no Frozen Domain pre-placed. The real question is whether you reach level 6 even on health. Then reverse the usual read on his ultimate: Dominus grants him bonus max Health, and Subjugate steals a percent of the target's Health as well as armour and MR — so the more he inflates himself, the more your ultimate takes. Cast Subjugate into Dominus rather than holding it. Use Pillar of Ice alongside it: when he dashes in, drop it behind him so the exit costs him the whole 16-second Slice and Dice cooldown and he finishes the fight inside your Frozen Domain.

edits.before: Once Trinity Force is on your back, this lane flips. Renekton without a kill lead is one of the worst late-game top laners in the game — his kit outputs burst damage in short windows, and every prolonged fight inside your Frozen Domain shreds that advantage. Chomp stacks AD theft over the fight, your King's Tribute heals off minion deaths, and Subjugate still drains enough armour to matter even from a non-tank opponent. Force him to trade long: drop W, Q-bite immediately, and use Pillar to trap him inside the zone. He cannot disengage cleanly once the pillar is between him and safety.
edits.after: Once Trinity Force is on your back, this lane flips. Renekton without a kill lead is one of the worst late-game top laners in the game — his kit outputs burst in short windows, and every prolonged fight inside your Frozen Domain shreds that advantage. Chomp saps his AD across the fight, King's Tribute heals you off every dying minion, and Subjugate takes a slice of the max Health that Dominus just handed him. Force him to trade long: drop W, Chomp immediately, and use Pillar of Ice to trap him inside the zone. With the pillar between him and safety, Slice and Dice is ten seconds from being an escape.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (Stun): matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Renekton Ruthless Predator: Empowered strike; with Fury it stuns longer — his all-in lockdown. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Ruthless Predator (W): 16/14/12/10/8s. At 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s and destroys damage shields on you. - Slice and Dice (E): 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s. Empowered it shreds your armour; Pillar behind him once it is spent.

edits.before: W down at your feet turns short trades your way: move speed, attack speed, and healing on your own terrain. Trade only inside the zone.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator lands at 16s on rank 1, and a 50-Fury cast stuns 1.5s. Frozen Domain will not rescue a trade he opens — farm it.

edits.before: Pillar closes the kit — use it behind Renekton to deny disengage, or between you and Ruthless Predator (Stun) to break his pattern.
edits.after: His level-3 rotation outruns your healing. Pillar of Ice behind him once Slice and Dice (16s) is spent is the only way the fight lasts.

edits.before: Q ranks raise the bite damage and the AD steal. Keep trading in W; if Renekton stands in your domain trading evenly, he is losing.
edits.after: He bleeds Fury between trades while Chomp ranks up. Cull the Meek (7s) heals him off the wave, so buy Grievous Wounds early.

edits.before: Subjugate online — the 1v1 is yours into almost anyone the moment Renekton commits. R early in the all-in so the drained resists count for the whole fight.
edits.after: Dominus hands him bonus max Health for the extended all-in. Subjugate takes a percent of that Health straight back, so answer his R with yours.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Bait it. When it is down — Bite + duel him.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator at 50 Fury: 1.5s stun, and it destroys damage shields. Bait it, then bite and duel him.

edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + Health Potion. Core: Trinity Force (the duel spike), then Spirit Visage; Sterak's Gage is dead gold — a 50-Fury Ruthless Predator destroys shields. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g).

notes: The existing text refers to Renekton's 'second E dash' / 'double-dash'. Riot's Slice and Dice description says only 'Renekton dashes' — the recast is not in the data available here, so I neither removed nor amplified it; flagging it as unverified. Also unverified and therefore not written: whether Pillar of Ice's terrain blocks Slice and Dice. Renekton is Fury-based with zero mana costs on all four abilities, which is why no mana-punish line was added.
